decisions.record_protection: lay flat on turntable without skipping

commitments.detail: Place turntable in center of coffee table for optimal sound and visibility.
Handle records gently to avoid damage during playback.
Ensure all guests arrive by 7:00 PM sharp for the start of the event.
Maintain volume at 85 dB to ensure comfort for all attendees.
Provide breaks every 30 minutes to allow guests to socialize and enjoy refreshments.
